answer_1.quote: ...We prompt GPT-4 (gpt-4-vision-preview) with the ground truth label, caption, and the image to explain the relationship between the image and the caption...

answer_2.quote: ...The ExplanationScore computes the average of BERTScore (2020) between model-generated and reference (V-FLUTE) explanations...

answer_4.quote: ...We recruit two expert annotators with background in linguistics ... ask whether the explanation is adequate (accurate, correct, complete and concise). If not, we ask them to identify one of the errors based on the following taxonomy: Hallucination, Unsound reasoning, Incomplete reasoning, Verbosity...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged the adequacy of each generated explanation and selected the dominant error type when inadequate.
criteria: error type (hallucination, unsound reasoning, incomplete reasoning, verbosity)
